## Summary

Describe the change and the user-facing or architectural result.

## Required review

- [ ] Feature-preservation impact reviewed
- [ ] Security impact reviewed
- [ ] Privacy impact reviewed
- [ ] Licensing/upstream provenance impact reviewed
- [ ] Glaze/accessibility impact reviewed when user-facing
- [ ] Visual assets audited when changed
- [ ] No secrets or reusable credentials added
- [ ] npm run policy:check passes
- [ ] Applicable lint/type/test/build checks pass
- [ ] Exact head revision is the revision reviewed for promotion

A merged pull request is not automatically a Stable or production release.
